name: WorldExam
summary: 通过相机、动作和语言条件检验世界模型控制遵循、空间一致性和交互反应。
summaryEn: Tests control adherence, spatial consistency and reactivity under camera, action and language conditioning.
scaleZh: 1,474 个测试案例；8 类任务
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载

wmNote: 案例来自多类场景，测试提示不等于带真实控制信号的采集轨迹。
wmNoteEn: Cases span multiple scene sources; test prompts are not equivalent to recorded trajectories with physical control signals.

evidence.locator: Overview; Three control interfaces; Eight evaluation tasks
evidence.statement: A defined world-model protocol tests scene revisits, terrain/object/social interactions, physical reaction and goal completion under three control interfaces. Released test cases support diagnostic evaluation beyond visual appearance.
